en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of two prominent buildings: a grand school building (läroverket) with ornate architecture and a tall church (kyrkan) with a pointed clocktower steeple, both set amongst trees. On the left, it reads 'Läroverket och Kyrkan, Sundsvall.' The lower right gives publisher information and the year 1901. Handwritten cursive Swedish text is present along the right and bottom edges, as well as on the reverse side, which also features a green Swedish stamp (5 öre) with a postmark, and address lines filled out.
